content: Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Dɑfidi u bikiɑ u nɛɛ, Sɔɔlun bweseru sɔɔ, ɡoo u ǹ mɑɑ tie, kpɑ n wɑ n yɛ̃ro durom kuɑ Yonɑtɑm sɔ̃?
N deemɑ sɔm kowo ɡoo u wɑ̃ɑ Sɔɔlun yɛnuɔ wi bɑ sokumɔ Sibɑ. Mɑ Dɑfidi u nùn sokusiɑ. Ye u nɑ, mɑ u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, wunɑ bɑ sokumɔ Sibɑ? Mɑ u wurɑ u nɛɛ, oo, nɛnɑ mi, yinni.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u nɛɛ, ɡoo sɑri wi u sɑ̃ɑ Sɔɔlun bweseru kpɑ n wɑ n yɛ̃ro durom kuɑ nɡe mɛ nɑ Yinni Gusunɔ nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ? Mɑ Sibɑ u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, Yonɑtɑm u bii ɡoo mɔ mi, wi u sɑ̃ɑ yɛmɔ.
Sinɑ boko u bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mɑnɑ u sere wɑ̃ɑ. Mɑ Sibɑ u nɛɛ, u wɑ̃ɑwɑ Mɑkiri, Amiɛlin biin yɛnuɔ Lodebɑɑɔ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u ɡɔrɑ Lodebɑɑ mi, bu nùn kɑsumɑ.
Yerɑ bɑ kɑ Mɛfibosɛti, Yonɑtɑm bii, Sɔɔlun debubu ɡe nɑ Dɑfidin mi. Mɑ u kpunɑ Dɑfidin wuswɑɑɔ u nùn bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃. Dɑfidi u nùn sokɑ u nɛɛ, Mɛfibosɛti. Mɑ u wurɑ u nɛɛ, nɛ wee, yinni.
Dɑfidi u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ku nɑndɑ. Duromɑ kon nun kuɑ kɑ ɡem wunɛn bɑɑbɑ Yonɑtɑm sɔ̃. Kon nun wunɛn debu Sɔɔlun tem kpuro wesiɑ. Yen biru ɑ n dɑ kɑ mɑn di sɑɑ bɑɑyere nɛn dii yerɔ.
Mɑ u mɑɑ kpunɑ u Dɑfidi bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃. U nɛɛ, yinni, mbɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɑ kɑ nɛn lɑɑkɑri mɔ mɛsum, nɛ wi nɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe bɔ̃ɔ ɡoru mini.
Yerɑ sinɑ boko u Sibɑ Sɔɔlun sɔm kowo sokɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɡɑ̃ɑ ni nu rɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ Sɔɔlu wunɛn yinniɡinu kpuro, kɑ ye yɑ sɑ̃ɑ win yɛnun bɑɑyere ɡesi, nɑ ye win debubu Mɛfibosɛti wɛ̃.

Tɛ̃ wunɛ kɑ wunɛn bibu kɑ wunɛn sɔm kowobu, bɛɛ kpurowɑ i ko i nùn wukuɑ, kpɑ u kɑ dĩɑnu wɑ u n dimɔ. Adɑmɑ Mɛfibosɛti wi, u ko n dɑ kɑ mɑn diwɑ bɑɑdommɑ nɛn dii yerɔ. N deemɑ Sibɑ wi, bii tɔn durɔbu wɔkurɑ nɔɔbuwɑ u mɔ. Win sɔm kowobu mɑɑ tɔnu yɛndu.
Mɑ u sinɑ boko wisɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, ye ɑ mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ kpuro, yerɑ kon ko. Mɑ Mɛfibosɛti u rɑ n dɑɑmɔ u n dimɔ Dɑfidin dii yerɔ, nɡe win bibun turo.
Mɛfibosɛti wi, u bii piibu ɡɑɡu mɔ ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Mikɑ. Mɑ tɔn be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Sibɑn yɛnuɔ kpuro bɑ kuɑ Mɛfibosɛtin sɔm kowobu.
Mɛfibosɛti, yɛmɔ wi, u dɑ u wɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ kpɑ u wɑ u n dɑ kɑ dim de sinɑ bokon dii yerɔ bɑɑdommɑ.
